llm_fields.description: The Kaimagga Vikasa Yojana, launched by the Department of Handloom & Textiles, Government of Karnataka, aims to sustain and develop handloom weaving skills of existing weavers and attract young talent, thereby preserving Karnataka's rich cultural heritage of handloom weaving.
llm_fields.eligibility: The weaver must be a member of a Handloom Weaver Co-operative Society, Handloom Association/Organisation or Karnataka Development Corporation, reside in their own or rented house, hold a Weaver's Identity Card, be a traditional weaver practising handloom weaving, or a young man or woman who has completed handloom weaving training under any government scheme and possesses the relevant certificate. For purchase of a warping machine, the weaver must have a certificate of experience in washing and adequate space to install the machine.
